usage: Manually verified reference sites for the Trainer's View workflow, not automated licensed racing telemetry and not authoritative model scores.

olbg.name: OLBG
olbg.rules: Tipster rankings change and can reflect survivorship bias. Only record actual tipster, number of tips and pre-race quoted price when independently checked. No blind consensus bonus.

myracing.name: myracing
areas: course-specific trainer and jockey records with sample sizes
myracing.rules: Course rates are historical summaries, not evidence of today's horse readiness. Capture source date and runner counts; racecourse guides may contain generalizations and should be checked against official race maps.

winners-enclosure.name: The Winners Enclosure
winners-enclosure.rules: Record author and publication time as well as race date and horse. Opinions alone are not sectionals, stable inside information, or proof of value. Do not claim independent agreement if syndicated.

licensing: Do not bulk scrape, republish site tips, or copy editorial text without permission. Summarise independently with attribution, timestamp and links.
assessment: A source-backed factual trainer/course stat may inform a hypothesis, while an editorial tip remains non-measurement. Mixed agreement is never used as a probability without out-of-sample validation.
